Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure
On October 21, 2026, The Electric published an article in which an officer of Enovix Corporation (the “Company”) stated that the Company “estimated that 2027 revenue will be around $100 million”, and that “[most] of that [revenue] … will be from smartphone customers ….”, and that Enovix “had shipped 50,000 cells to a smartphone maker that was prototyping a new model ….”


The 2027 estimated revenue disclosed in the article was not a Company-authorized disclosure, and investors should not rely on those statements as Company guidance for 2027. The Company expects to provide its updated financial guidance when it releases its third quarter 2026 financial results on November 12, 2026. The Company notes that its current expectation is that revenue growth will be primarily driven by its drone, defense and industrial pipeline, which was $216 million as of the end of the third quarter of 2026, as previously disclosed by the Company. The Company also would like to clarify that the shipments referenced in the article were to a smart eyewear customer, not a smartphone maker, and that, as previously disclosed, the Company had shipped approximately 17,000 production sample cells to that customer as of the end of the third quarter of 2026, out of a 50,000 pack order.


The information in this report is being furnished pursuant to Item 7.01 of Form 8-K and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act.

Forward-looking statements in this Form 8-K include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the expected timing of the release of the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results and updated guidance, and the Company’s expectation that its revenue growth will be primarily driven by its drone, defense and industrial pipeline. Risks, uncertainties and assumptions that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results and events anticipated by such forward-looking statements include risks relating to the Company’s expected drone, defense and industrial pipeline and the conversion of that pipeline into revenue, the timing of the release of the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results, and other risks described in the disclosures contained in the Company’s filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”), including in the “Risk Factors” and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” sections of its annual report on Form 10-K and quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, and other documents that its has filed, or will file, with the SEC.
